thread:
jamie: heads up — main CI turned red right after merge from #3124, looks like the integration-evals job timed out. commit a1b2c3d
ci-bot: [ALERT] pipeline/main - integration-evals (job id: 98765) FAILED after 45m (timeout)
jamie: stack trace snippet in job logs shows repeated gRPC stall: 
```
INFO: sending request to eval-runner
WARN: rpc call to evaluator stalled at 10s
INFO: retry attempt 3
ERROR: deadline exceeded
```
devon: @jamie thanks for flagging — do we know if this was caused by the new model artifact in the merge or infra? any flaky signal in previous runs?
rachel: I checked last 5 successful runs — they were ~6m. This one ramped then hung around 12-15s per RPC and then timed out. No recent infra deploys in the window. :thinking:
jamie: suspicious that the patch changed batching behavior in the eval harness (PR touched eval/runner and model adapter). cc @devon who reviewed the PR.
devon: I can take a first pass. If it's the harness change, we should hotfix or revert. Can someone trigger a rerun while I grab logs? /rerun job 98765
ci-bot: command accepted: rerun queued (job 98765 -> rerun id 98766)
ci-bot: rerun started (98766)
sre-oncall: I'm watching infra — no visible node pressure, GPU mem stable, network egress within normal. If rerun fails, we'll bisect.
jamie: thanks. while rerun runs, can someone grep for the failing test name? I'm seeing `eval-runner/integration/test_inference_latency` in the failing task
rachel: grabbing logs, one sec. snippet: `INFO input_size=512 batch=8 kv_cache_miss=0.04 latency=230ms` then later `WARN grpc: connection stuck, inflight=32`
devon: if inflight climbs, likely a request fanout bug in the new batching. Put a temporary concurrency cap in the harness? quick patch: set MAX_INFLIGHT=16 and rerun.
jamie: can you push that as a hotfix branch and request a rerun? if we need to revert PR #3124, we should coordinate now.
devon: pushed hotfix branch `hotfix/eval-concurrency-cap` -> will queue a rerun on that job once the image builds. @ci-bot can you build image from `hotfix/eval-concurrency-cap` and run integration-evals? :pray:
ci-bot: build started for hotfix/eval-concurrency-cap (image: ghcr.io/redwood/hotfix-eval:618222)
ci-bot: build complete, triggered integration-evals (job id: 98767)
jamie: :eyes: nice. SRE, if this continues to fail we should consider a rollback of the model artifact to the previous known-good image (tag: eval-prod:20260310)
sre-oncall: agreed — I'll prepare rollback playbook and hold off unless rerun fails. also set an alert to page if 3 consecutive reruns fail.
rachel: rerun 98766 completed — failed with same grpc stall. 98767 (hotfix) is still running.
devon: if 98767 passes then it's the harness concurrency, we cut a small release. if it fails, revert PR 3124 asap and bisect the PR.
ci-bot: job 98767 SUCCESS in 7m 32s
jamie: great — looks like the concurrency cap fixed it. devon, can you open PR to merge the hotfix to main and include a test to catch inflight growth? add a short blurb in the release notes.
devon: will do. creating PR now and notifying QA for a quick smoke. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3182
rachel: leaving a note in the incident log and tagging teams. folks, good job triaging quickly. :thumbsup:
jamie: closing the loop — no rollback needed. assigning follow-up to devon for permanent fix and to eng-qa to add a regression test. I'll update the post-merge checklist to include an eval smoke run for 10m baseline.
ci-bot: incident closed (alert cleared)
sre-oncall: leaving a postmortem note for the window 6182223333-6182223345 — will add metrics and timeline.
jamie: thanks everyone. if anything reoccurs ping here or page SRE.
